text: This staff report is about a matter that the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to recommend installing stop control for eastbound traffic on Brookers Lane at the intersection of Annie Craig Drive. This intersection is currently controlled with a stop control for northbound traffic at Annie Craig Drive and the installation of stop control on Brookers Lane will enhance traffic management and safety at this location.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Designated Brookers Lane, between the west side of Annie Craig Drive and the east end of Brookers Lane, as a through highway.
